Beast Riders.note: Participates in external trade while conducting frontier or desert raids that raise escort costs and shift cargo flows.

Coyote Kingdom.note: Participates in external trade while conducting frontier or desert raids that raise escort costs and shift cargo flows.

Dam Basin Salvagers.note: Boatmurder salvagers & highwaymen preying on caravans along the NE Dam Basin and semi-arid highways.

Empire of Iziz.note: At war with Vothic Kingdom (mutual port closure, Ring Sea commerce raids, trade only via smugglers at Port Mira or neutral Dhelv/Kautoa intermediaries); hostile to Beast Riders; armed convoys on Dilihan-Port Visas; Port Tobin relocated to Riv 12 estuary.

Fellgangs.note: Participates in external trade while conducting frontier or desert raids that raise escort costs and shift cargo flows.

Free Giants (Vrivolci).note: Participates in external trade while conducting frontier or desert raids that raise escort costs and shift cargo flows.

Frogmen.note: SW Highlands native Frogmen (Krrmt & Jrrmiah); raid neighboring marches (Voth, Yusar, Republic, Shumari) EXCEPT Realm of Dalab, with whom they maintain a peace treaty via Span.

Hookfleet.note: Rump navy of old Hook based at Port Mira on SE Throne — premier Ring Sea smuggling port & wartime prize intermediary between Iziz and Voth.

Jabal Shiekdom.note: Independent Dasri oasis sheikhdom in the eastern Bowl (Jabal & Bowl Salt Works); major exporter of salt, pack camels/mounts, myrrh incense, and tamarisk-manna sugar.

Kimr.note: Semi-nomadic Pleistocene megafauna hunters gathered round the sacred ruined arcology of Hall of Heroes in the Labyrinth; primary exporter of mammoth/pachyderm ivory, horn, and heavy hides via dirt trails.

Lizardmen.note: Trades strictly internally among Sauropolis, Komodo, Gila, and Tuatara; hostile to humans — zero external trade, and raids Vale of Xanadu and southern Dalab/Fellgangs.

Nomad Country.note: Participates in external trade while conducting frontier or desert raids that raise escort costs and shift cargo flows.

Painted Men.note: Participates in external trade while conducting frontier or desert raids that raise escort costs and shift cargo flows.

Ring Sea Pirates.note: Maritime freebooters operating out of Noa's Regret, Shanty (East Ring Isles), and Boiling Bay (Steampits), intercepting Ring Sea shipping and fencing captured prizes.

Screamer Country.note: Screamer raiders (Hexahedron) do not trade externally — raid passing caravans and neighboring marches for supplies and captives; zero external exports or imports.

Scyvoi.note: Participates in external trade while conducting frontier or desert raids that raise escort costs and shift cargo flows.

Shell Province.note: At war with Vothic Kingdom (mutual port closure, Ring Sea commerce raids, trade only via smugglers at Port Mira or neutral Dhelv/Kautoa intermediaries); hostile to Beast Riders; armed convoys on Dilihan-Port Visas; Port Tobin relocated to Riv 12 estuary.

Silkhead (Korona Gateway).note: Independent gateway town at the foot of the Korona Silk River assembling wild silk, cordage, orchil dyes, and snow-lotus reagents.

Tabisti: Liikofi.note: Independent Tabisti city-state exporting worked Abyssal scrapgoods, structural scrap, cotton, and coal over Eastern Nomad desert tracks.

Tabisti: Sfenops.note: Independent Tabisti city-state exporting worked Abyssal scrapgoods, structural scrap, cotton, and coal over Eastern Nomad desert tracks.

Tiguantin.note: Iziz tributary polity on the Eastern Highlands & Lesser Throne centered at Guari (1095, 911); linked to the Imperial Izani highway network via Talia and exports wormwick medicine, pallidine tower honey, puna qiviut/plaid, and First Monastery lava-tube relics.

Vothic Kingdom.note: At war with Empire of Iziz & Shell Province (mutual port closure, Ring Sea commerce raids, trade only via smugglers at Port Mira or neutral Dhelv/Kautoa intermediaries); commercial rival of Hykkousoi League; raided by Vrivolci & Frogmen.

Yeti Kingdom.note: Raids the Eternal State and relations are fraught — zero direct bilateral trade with Eternia; trades indirectly via Dam Basin Salvagers, Jimjam, Iron Republic, and Free Clans.
